DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お名前の変更についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to discuss changing your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。結婚で姓が変わりました。この用紙の二つの名前の欄に、何を書くか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 改姓用紙の二氏名欄記入法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My surname changed when I got married. Please tell me what to write in the two name fields on this form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to fill in the two name fields on the surname-change form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらが前のお名前、こちらが今のお名前です。下のお名前も含めて、両方へご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is for your former name, and this is for your current name. Please enter both, including your given name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前は山田花、今は高橋花です。どちらの欄も、姓と名前を続けて書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 架空旧山田花現高橋花を各フルネームで記すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My former name was Hana Yamada, and my current name is Hana Takahashi. I wrote my surname followed by my given name in both fields.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will enter the fictional former name Hana Yamada and current name Hana Takahashi as full names in their respective fields. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 口座に登録されたお名前は、前の山田花でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is your account registered under your former name, Hana Yamada?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。通帳には前の名前が残っています。名前の変更をまだ銀行へ届けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通帳旧名登録と改姓届出未済を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. My passbook still has my former name. I have not notified the bank of my name change yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your passbook is registered under your former name and you have not yet reported the surname change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要なご本人の資料は、担当からご案内します。変更後の表記を確認できる物はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will explain which personal documents you need. Do you have anything that shows how your new name is written?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらの書類があります。今日の用紙と一緒に見ていただき、ほかに必要な物があれば知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現表記資料を示し不足本人資料を確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have this document. I would like you to look at it together with today's form and tell me if anything else is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show a document bearing your current name and ask to check whether any personal documents are missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へそのご希望を伝えます。ご連絡先は変わっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass that request on to the person in charge. Have your contact details changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 携帯番号は同じです。前と今のフルネームを書けたので、通帳と書類を合わせて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同じ連絡先と両氏名記入済を伝え通帳資料で相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: My mobile number is the same. Now that I have written my former and current full names, I will discuss this with my passbook and documents together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that your contact details are unchanged and both names have been entered, and consult using your passbook and documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へおつなぎします。書類をお手元にお持ちください。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will put you in touch with the person in charge. Please keep your documents handy. Thank you for coming in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計は三百二十円です。カードをお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your total is 320 yen. Do you have a card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このポイントのカードがあります。これを出せば、支払いも終わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 架空三百二十円会計でポイントカードだけで決済完了か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have this points card. If I present it, does that complete the payment too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: For a fictional 320-yen purchase, ask whether presenting only the points card completes payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: このカードにはポイントを記録します。代金は、別にお支払いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We record points on this card. Please pay for the purchase separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。ポイントを付けるためのカードなのですね。支払いは現金にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ポイント記録と代金別払いを理解し現金支払を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. So it is a card for collecting points. I will pay in cash.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the points are recorded separately from payment and choose to pay in cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、カードを先に確認します。こちらへお置きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the card first. Please put it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 置きました。五百円玉もありますが、カードの処理が終わってから出した方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先にカードを置き五百円投入の順を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have put it down. I also have a 500-yen coin. Should I wait until you finish processing the card before putting it down?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put the card down first and ask when to put in the 500 yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: カードをお返しします。ポイントの記録は済みましたので、五百円をお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is your card back. The points have been recorded, so I will take the 500 yen now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: カードを受け取りました。五百円をこの台へ置きます。代金は三百二十円でしたね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カード返却を受け五百円を台に置き三百二十円を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my card back. I will put the 500 yen on this tray. The total was 320 yen, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Take back the card, put 500 yen on the tray, and confirm the total of 320 yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。百八十円のお釣りと、レシートです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Here is your 180 yen in change and your receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 百八十円を受け取りました。カードと現金の支払いを、それぞれ済ませられました。商品も持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 百八十円釣りを受取りカード処理と現金決済完了を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have received the 180 yen. The card processing and cash payment are both complete. I will take my purchase home too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive the 180 yen in change and say that the card processing and cash payment are complete. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご利用いただきありがとうございました。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for shopping with us. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地図で、歩く道をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a walking route on the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。定規ではこの道が三センチでしたが、実際にどのくらい歩くのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 定規三センチの散歩経路実距離を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I measured this route as three centimeters with a ruler, but I do not know how far I would actually walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the actual distance of a walking route that measures three centimeters with a ruler. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この地図の縮尺では、一センチが二百メートルです。三センチでしたら六百メートルになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this map's scale, one centimeter represents 200 meters. Three centimeters would be 600 meters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 六百メートルですね。紙の上の三センチをそのまま短い道と思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 縮尺一センチ二百メートルから六百メートルと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is 600 meters. I had thought that three centimeters on paper meant a short route as it was.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand that the scale of one centimeter to 200 meters makes the distance 600 meters. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの道を、定規で測りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Which route did you measure with the ruler?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この曲がった道です。まっすぐ端から端までではなく、曲がり角で分けて長さを足しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 曲道を角ごとに区分し経路沿い合計測定と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: This winding route. Rather than measuring straight from one end to the other, I split it at the corners and added the lengths.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you divided the winding route at each corner and added the measurements along the route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その道に沿って測った合計が三センチでしたら、六百メートルとして見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: If the total you measured along that route was three centimeters, you can treat it as 600 meters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。帰りに使う別の道は二センチなので、四百メートルですね。二つを合わせると一キロです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰路二センチ四百メートルと往復一キロを計算する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. The other route I will take back is two centimeters, so that is 400 meters. Together, the two routes total one kilometer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Calculate that the two-centimeter return route is 400 meters and the round trip is one kilometer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その経路を、メモに残されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like to make a note of that route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。行き六百メートル、帰り四百メートルと書きます。時間は自分の歩く速さで変わるので、距離のメモとして持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 往復別距離を控え歩行時間保証でなく距離記録として使う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will write 600 meters going out and 400 meters coming back. The time depends on how fast I walk, so I will carry it as a distance note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Note the separate distances for each direction and use them as a distance record, not a guarantee of walking time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、地図をお役立てください。お足元にお気をつけて、散歩をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22223-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please make use of the map. Watch your step and enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの券について、お尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the ticket you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: これで電車に乗ろうと思いました。会社でもらった券ですが、この駅から使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社の券を列車に使えるか現物で尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was planning to take the train with this. I received it from my company. Can I use it from this station?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the ticket from your company and ask whether you can use it for the train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは、表にバスの回数券と書かれています。列車の切符とは別の券です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The front says this is a bus multi-ride ticket. It is a different kind of ticket from a train ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: バスの券だったのですね。駅へ来るバスでは使わず、ここまで現金で払いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 券がバス用と理解し駅まで現金払いだったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it was a bus ticket. I did not use it on the bus to the station; I paid cash to get here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the ticket is for buses and say that you paid cash to reach the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 列車で向かう先を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me where you are going by train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この案内の青葉駅へ行きます。列車の切符はまだ買っていないので、片道を一枚お願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 架空青葉駅へ列車券未購入で片道一枚を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am going to Aoba Station shown in this guide. I have not bought a train ticket yet, so please give me one one-way ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request one one-way train ticket to the fictional Aoba Station, explaining that you have not bought one yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの案内では、青葉駅まで三百円です。お持ちのバス券はご自身で保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: According to this guide, the fare to Aoba Station is 300 yen. Please keep your bus ticket yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三百円で一枚ですね。バス券は別のポケットへ入れ、この列車の券と混ざらないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三百円を確認してバス券を別ポケットへしまう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: One ticket for 300 yen, correct? I will put the bus ticket in a separate pocket so that I do not mix it up with this train ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the 300-yen fare and put the bus ticket in a separate pocket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが青葉駅までの切符です。行き先をお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is your ticket to Aoba Station. Please check the destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 青葉駅と読めました。列車には今買った方を使います。会社の券の使い方は、帰って担当者へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新券の行先を読み会社券は後で担当へ確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can read Aoba Station on it. I will use the one I just bought for the train. When I get back, I will ask the person in charge how to use the company ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Read the destination on the new ticket and say that you will ask the person in charge about the company ticket later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、乗り場の案内をご覧ください。よいお出かけになりますように。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the directions to the platform. Have a pleasant trip. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 道路の照明についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss road lighting, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨夜、曲がり角の街灯が暗かったです。柱の番号を写したつもりですが、この数字で場所が分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨夜暗い街灯について写した数字で位置が分かるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Last night, the streetlight at the corner was dim. I thought I had photographed the pole number. Can you identify the location from these digits?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the digits you photographed can identify the location of the streetlight that was dim last night. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この写真の数字は、柱に貼られた広告の電話番号のようです。街灯を示す番号とは分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The digits in this photo appear to be the phone number on an advertisement attached to the pole. We will check it separately from the number identifying the streetlight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 広告だったのですね。街灯の番号と思い込んでいました。柱全体の写真も撮りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 数字が広告と理解し柱全景写真もあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it was an advertisement. I had assumed it was the streetlight number. I also took a photo of the whole pole.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the digits are from an advertisement and say that you also have a photo of the whole pole. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 全体の写真を見せてください。場所の目印はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show me the photo of the whole pole. Are there any landmarks nearby?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。パン屋の向かいで、赤い橋へ曲がる角です。地図にも、その角へ丸を付けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: パン屋向かい赤橋角の位置と地図印を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. It is opposite the bakery, at the corner where you turn toward the red bridge. I also circled that corner on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the location opposite the bakery at the red-bridge corner and the mark on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真と地図を担当へお伝えします。暗かったのは、いつご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass the photo and map to the person in charge. When did you notice that it was dim?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日の午後八時ごろです。昼の写真は場所を見せるためで、昨夜の明るさは写っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 昨夜二十時の状況と昼写真の目的を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Around eight yesterday evening. The daytime photo is to show the location; it does not show how bright it was last night.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain separately the situation at 8 p.m. last night and the purpose of the daytime photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご連絡先をこちらへお願いします。設備の確認は担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please put your contact details here. I will hand over the equipment inspection to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号を書きました。広告の数字ではなく、柱の写真と地図の丸、昨夜八時の状況で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を出し広告番号でなく写真地図時刻で相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written my number. I am reporting this using the pole photo, the circle on the map, and the situation at eight last night, rather than the digits on the advertisement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Provide your contact details and report the issue using the photo, map, and time instead of the advertisement's number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、その内容で担当へおつなぎします。お知らせいただきありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass those details to the person in charge. Thank you for letting us know. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの睡眠のメモについて、確認したいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there something you would like to check about your sleep notes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜中に目が覚めた時刻を書きました。でも、寝た日と同じ日付にしたので、前後が分かりにくくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜中の覚醒時刻を就寝日付へ書き前後不明と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote down the time I woke up during the night. But I used the date on which I went to bed, so the sequence has become hard to understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you recorded a nighttime awakening under the bedtime date and the sequence is unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 覚えている日付と時刻を、順に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the dates and times you remember in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 月曜の夜十一時に布団へ入り、次に時計を見たのは火曜の午前一時でした。一時も月曜と書いていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 月曜二十三時寝床と火曜一時の時計確認を具体的に話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I got into bed at eleven on Monday night, and the next time I looked at the clock was one on Tuesday morning. I had written Monday for one o'clock too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specifically describe getting into bed at 23:00 on Monday and checking the clock at 1:00 on Tuesday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 日付が変わったことも、担当へ分かるように添えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also note that the date changed so the person in charge can understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 月曜二十三時、火曜一時と書き直します。火曜の欄が離れたページにあるので、夜中の分もそこへ移したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 月曜二十三時火曜一時へ訂正し離れた火曜ページへ移したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will correct it to Monday at 23:00 and Tuesday at 1:00. The Tuesday section is on a separate page farther away, so I would like to move the nighttime entry there too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will correct the entries to Monday at 23:00 and Tuesday at 1:00 and want to move the latter to the separate Tuesday page. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 火曜のページへ移す時は、時刻も一緒に残してください。ほかにも火曜の記録がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: When you move it to the Tuesday page, please keep the time with it. Do you have any other Tuesday entries?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 朝六時に起きた記録があります。一時の行を六時より前へ入れ、昼の記録と順番が逆にならないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 火曜六時起床記録より前に一時の行を入れると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a record of getting up at six in the morning. I will put the one-o'clock line before the six-o'clock line so that it does not end up in the wrong order with the daytime entries.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will insert the one-o'clock line before Tuesday's six-o'clock wake-up entry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 元の月曜の行には、移したことが分かる印を付けておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please mark the original Monday line to show that it has been moved.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 月曜の一時の行へ訂正の印を付けました。火曜には一時、その下に六時と並びました。二つのページを一緒に診察へ持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元の月曜行へ訂正印を付け火曜時刻順を確認し両頁を持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I marked the Monday one-o'clock line as corrected. Tuesday now lists one o'clock with six o'clock below it. I will take both pages together to my appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you marked the original Monday line as corrected, checked Tuesday's chronological order, and will bring both pages. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、メモをお手元に残してお待ちください。担当へご説明いただけます。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep your notes with you while you wait. You can explain them to the person in charge. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの反射材を、ご利用になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to use this reflector?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いただきたいです。鞄のポケットへ入れて持ち歩けばよいと思いましたが、外へ付ける物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 配布反射材を内ポケットへ入れる物と思い装着場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like one. I thought I could carry it inside a pocket in my bag. Is it something to attach on the outside?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the distributed reflector went inside a pocket and ask where to attach it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見える場所へ付けて使う物です。この帯は、鞄の持ち手にも巻けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You attach it somewhere visible. This strip can also be wrapped around a bag handle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この持ち手へ巻いてみたいです。荷物を持つ時に、手を入れる所までふさがない位置を探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持ち手へ巻き握る場所を残す位置を探すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to try wrapping it around this handle. I will look for a position that does not block the space where I put my hand when carrying the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will wrap it around the handle and find a position that leaves room to grip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 持ち手の下の部分でしたら、握る所を残せます。帯の端をこちらへ重ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The lower part of the handle would leave the gripping area free. Overlap the end of the strip here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 巻けました。ただ、鞄を肩へ掛けると体の内側へ隠れます。反対の持ち手にも試してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 巻いた帯が肩掛け時内側へ隠れ反対側試用を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have wrapped it around. But when I put the bag over my shoulder, it is hidden against my body. May I try the other handle too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the wrapped strip is hidden on the inside when the bag is on your shoulder and ask to try the opposite side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。外側から見える位置を、ご自身の持ち方で確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Go ahead. Check that it is visible from outside while holding the bag as you normally do.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらへ付け直しました。肩へ掛けても帯が外に見え、手も入れられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 付直し後外から見え手も入る位置と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have reattached it here. The strip is visible on the outside even with the bag on my shoulder, and I can still put my hand through.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that after reattaching it, it is visible from outside and there is still room for your hand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お使いになる時は、反射材だけを頼りにせず周囲も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: When using it, please also check your surroundings rather than relying only on the reflector.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分の鞄に付けたこの帯を持ち帰ります。ポケットにしまうのでなく、今の場所で使ってみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 反射材のみ頼らず鞄外の現位置で使用すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will take this strip home attached to my bag. I will try using it in its current position instead of putting it in a pocket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not rely solely on the reflector and will use it in its current position on the outside of your bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お役立てください。夜道でもお気をつけてお帰りください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please make use of it. Take care on your way home, including on dark roads. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この封筒についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss this envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人への手紙を入れましたが、外から本文の文字が見えます。宛名だけを外へ出したかったので、封をする前に変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薄封筒から本文が見え封前に変更したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put a letter to a friend inside, but the writing in the letter is visible from outside. I wanted only the address to be visible, so I would like to change it before sealing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the letter is visible through the thin envelope and you want to change it before sealing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紙が薄く、中の文字が透けていますね。中身は、そのままお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The paper is thin, so the writing inside shows through. Will you use the contents as they are?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。手紙は書き終わったので書き直さず、家から持ってきた厚い封筒へ入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 書き終えた手紙を維持し持参厚封筒へ替えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I have finished writing the letter, so rather than rewriting it, I would like to put it in the thick envelope I brought from home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the completed letter and switch to the thick envelope you brought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そちらの封筒で、大きさもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the size of that envelope too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入ります。今の薄い封筒へ書いた住所は、厚い方へ新しく写します。まだ切手は貼っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大きさ適合と宛名転記と切手未貼付を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It fits. I will copy the address I wrote on the current thin envelope onto the thick one afresh. I have not attached a stamp yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the size fits, you will copy the address, and no stamp has been attached yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中身を入れた状態で、外側の表示も見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us also look at the writing on the outside with the contents inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本文は外から読めなくなりました。厚い方の宛名は読めます。薄い封筒には、もう何も残っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本文が透けず新宛名可読と旧封筒空を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The letter can no longer be read from outside. The address on the thick envelope is legible. There is nothing left in the thin envelope now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the letter no longer shows through, the new address is legible, and the old envelope is empty. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お出しになる前に、宛先と差出人の記載を見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before sending it, please check the recipient and sender details again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 両方確認しました。手紙一枚を厚い封筒へ入れ、今から封をします。薄い方は自分で持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛先差出人確認後一枚封入し旧封筒持帰りを話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked both. I have put one sheet of letter paper in the thick envelope and will seal it now. I will take the thin one home myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after checking the recipient and sender, you will enclose one sheet and take the old envelope home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、準備できましたら窓口へお出しください。ご確認ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring it to the counter when it is ready. Thank you for checking. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の内容についてのお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the details of your appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日の窓口予約で、相談の種類を間違えました。相続を選びましたが、自分の口座の住所変更を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 明日予約の相続選択を本人口座住所変更へ訂正したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I chose the wrong type of consultation for tomorrow's counter appointment. I selected inheritance, but I want to discuss changing the address on my own account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to correct tomorrow's appointment category from inheritance to an address change on your own account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約の控えを拝見します。相続に関するご相談ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see your appointment confirmation. So this is not a consultation about inheritance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。誰かの口座を引き継ぐ話ではありません。私が引っ越したので、本人の住所の変更です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 他人口座の承継でなく本人転居と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: That is right. This is not about taking over someone else's account. I moved, so it is a change to my own address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that this concerns your own move, not succeeding to someone else's account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのご用件を担当へ伝えます。日時も変えるご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will pass that purpose on to the person in charge. Do you also want to change the date and time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明日の午後二時には来られます。日時はそのままにできるか、相談の種類と分けて確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 日時二時維持可否を相談種別と分けて尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can come at two tomorrow afternoon. I would like to check whether I can keep the date and time separately from the consultation category.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can keep the two-o'clock appointment time, separately from the consultation category. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当の確認後に、受付の方法をご案内します。ご連絡先は予約時と同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: After the person in charge has checked, we will explain how to check in. Are your contact details the same as when you booked?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ携帯番号です。新しい予約をもう一つ作らず、この控えの内容の訂正として連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡先不変で新予約を重ねず既存控え訂正を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is the same mobile number. I am contacting you to correct the details on this confirmation, without making another new appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that your contact details are unchanged and request a correction to the existing confirmation without making a duplicate appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 住所変更について、確認したい点もございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is there anything you would like to check about the address change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 持参する物を知りたいです。明日二時の枠を使えるかと、住所変更に必要な資料を、担当の方へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二時枠使用可否と住所変更持参資料を担当へ確認希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would like to know what to bring. I will ask the person in charge whether I can use tomorrow's two-o'clock slot and what documents are needed for the address change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to check with the person in charge whether you can use the two-o'clock slot and what documents to bring for the address change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、その二点を担当へお伝えします。確認のご連絡をお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass those two questions to the person in charge. Please wait for us to contact you with confirmation. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そのネット袋も、お買い上げになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be buying that mesh bag too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。今日買って、野菜を入れるのに使いたいです。持参した自分の袋ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ネット袋を本日購入商品として今使いたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to buy it today and use it for the vegetables. It is not my own bag brought from home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the mesh bag is an item you are buying today and want to use now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋の値札を登録してから、お使いいただけます。中にはまだ何も入れていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can use it after I scan the bag's price tag. You have not put anything inside yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 空のままです。先に野菜を入れると値札が隠れるので、袋だけこちらへ出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 値札が隠れないよう空袋を先登録へ出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is still empty. If I put the vegetables in first, they will hide the price tag, so I will hand over just the bag here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Hand over the empty bag to be scanned first so that the price tag is not hidden. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋を登録しました。野菜もご一緒にお会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have scanned the bag. I will ring up the vegetables together with it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この玉ねぎ三個もお願いします。袋の口のひもは、会計後に結んで持ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 玉ねぎ三個を会計依頼し会計後袋口を結ぶと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: These three onions too, please. I would like to tie the drawstring at the opening after paying and then carry it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to pay for three onions and say that you will tie the bag opening after checkout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お会計が済みました。ネット袋と玉ねぎをお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Your payment is complete. Here are your mesh bag and onions back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受け取りました。玉ねぎを一つずつ入れて、ひもを閉めます。レシートの袋の行も残しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会計済袋と野菜を受領し三個収納と袋行のレシート保管を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have received them. I will put the onions in one by one and close the drawstring. I will also keep the line for the bag on the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have received the paid-for bag and vegetables, will put in the three onions, and will retain the receipt showing the bag line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかのお品物も、この袋へ入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will you put your other items in this bag too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 柔らかい桃は別に持ちます。ネットには玉ねぎ三個だけ入りました。次回はこの袋を持参して使うつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 桃を別にし購入袋は玉ねぎ専用で次回持参利用すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will carry the soft peaches separately. Only the three onions are in the mesh bag. Next time, I plan to bring this bag with me and use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the peaches separate, use the purchased bag only for the onions, and bring it to use next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、二つを分けて大切にお持ち帰りください。お買い上げありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep the two separate and carry them home carefully. Thank you for your purchase.
